blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a fundamental NLP task concerned with the identification and categorization of subjective information in text. While lexicon-based methods offer transparency, they often struggle with linguistic phenomena such as negation and intensification. Syntactic parsing has been integrated into SA pipelines to address this, but conventional parsers introduce significant computational overhead. Recent work shows that reformulating dependency parsing as a Sequence Labeling (SEL) task can improve efficiency. We propose and compare two strategies for integrating syntactic knowledge into a neural sentiment analysis model under unified Multi-Task Learning (MTL). The first, Standard-MTL, jointly learns dependency parsing (via sequence labeling) and sentiment polarity classification using a shared encoder with two task-specific heads. The second, Contrastive-MTL, provides implicit syntactic guidance through a contrastive auxiliary objective and a syntax-biased attention pooling mechanism, without requiring explicit label prediction. Both rely on syntactic annotations during training and eliminate need for hand-crafted compositional rules or external parsing at inference. We evaluate eleven datasets spanning seven languages---the MARC corpus (English, Spanish, French, German) and seven datasets from SemEval-2022 Task 10 (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, Catalan)---using four established SEL encodings. With the relative encoding, Contrastive-MTL outperforms a syntax-naive baseline on 10 of 11 datasets and surpasses the external rule-based pipeline (SELSP) that parses at inference on all six datasets where the latter applies, while being 1.5--9$\times$ faster at evaluation. Standard-MTL is more dataset- and encoding-dependent. These results show implicit syntactic supervision during training can match or exceed explicit parsing at inference without computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 感知分析(SA)是NLP的一项基本任务,涉及文本中主观信息的识别和分类. 虽然基于词汇的方法提供了透明度,但它们往往与否定和强化等语言现象作斗争。 为解决这一问题,将协同剖析纳入SA管道,但常规剖析器引入了重大的计算间接费用。 最近的工作显示,将依赖性重新定位为序列标签(SEL)任务可以提高效率。 我们提出和比较两个策略,将综合知识纳入统一多任务学习(MTL)下的神经情绪分析模型. 第一种是标准-MTL,联合学习依赖解析(通过序列标签)和情感极性分类,使用一个共享编码器,其中有两个任务特定头. 第二部"Contrastive-MTL"通过对比性辅助目标和语法偏差的注意力集合机制提供隐含的合成指导,而不需要明确的标签预测. 两者在训练期间都依赖综合说明,并消除了手动编译规则或外部解析推论的需要. 我们评价了11个涵盖7种语言的数据集——MARCecurity(英语,西班牙语,法语,德语)和来自SemEval-2022 Status 10(英语,西班牙语,挪威语,巴斯克语,加泰罗尼亚语)的7个数据集——使用四种既定的SEL编码. 由于相对编码,Contrastive-MTL在11个数据集中的10个数据集上超过了语法负基准,并超越了外部基于规则的管道(SELSP),该管道对后者适用的所有6个数据集进行推论,而评价速度则更快,为1.5-9美元\时间. 标准-MTL更依赖数据集和编码. 这些结果表明,在培训期间进行隐含的合成监督可以匹配或超过明确的推断,而无需计算间接费用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a fundamental task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) that deals with the identification and categorization of subjective information in a given text, typically involving subjectivity detection and polarity classification (e.g., positive, negative, or neutral) Cui et al. (2023) .
In this article, we focus on sentiment polarity classification: given an input text x x (a sentence or document), predict its overall sentiment polarity y ∈ 𝒴 y\in\mathcal{Y} , where 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} typically contains labels such as positive, negative, and neutral. This is a sentence- or document-level classification task. We do not address fine-grained tasks like structured or aspect-based sentiment analysis.
blocks.zh:
感知分析(SA)是自然语言处理(NLP)中的一项基本任务,涉及在特定文本中识别和分类主观信息,一般涉及主观检测和极性分类(如阳性,负性,或中性). Cui等 (2023) (中文(简体) ).
在本篇文章中,我们关注情绪极性分类:给一个输入文本 xx(句子或文档),预测其整体情绪极性 y y\ y\in\ mathcal{Y},其中 Y\mathcal{Y} 通常包含正,负,中等标签. 这是句子或文件级的分类任务. 我们不处理结构化或以方面为基础的情绪分析等精细的任务。

blocks.en: Lexicon-based approaches leverage sentiment dictionaries like SO-CAL Brooke et al. (2009) to detect polarity-bearing words, providing an intuitive and transparent approach to SA. The explainability of lexicon-based methods stands in contrast to that of “black-box” supervised machine learning models. In lexicon-based approaches, the predicted sentiment can be traced directly to specific lexical items, whereas supervised models, despite often achieving high accuracy, obscure the reasoning behind their predictions Cui et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 基于Lexicon的方法利用SO-CAL Brooke等人(2009年)等情绪词典来检测含有极性词,为SA提供了直观和透明的方法. 以词汇为基础的方法与“黑盒”监督机器学习模型的可解释性形成对照。 在基于词典的方法中,预测的情绪可以直接追溯到具体的词典项目,而受监督的模型尽管经常达到很高的精确度,却模糊了预测Cui等人(2023年)背后的推理.

blocks.en: However, the accuracy of lexicon-based approaches depends on the handling of linguistic phenomena such as negation (“not good”) and intensification (“very good”), which have the tendency to shift or modify sentiment polarity. The scope of these linguistic phenomena is quite complex. To handle it properly, researchers have integrated syntactic parsing within rule-based SA systems Vilares et al. (2017) ; Imran et al. (2026b) . By analyzing the syntactic structure of a sentence-often represented via Universal Dependencies (UD) Zeman et al. (2023) , rule-based systems can apply recursive, compositional rules to accurately determine the scope of polarity-shifting elements. Despite these advantages in accuracy and explainability, conventional syntactic parsers, such as Stanza Qi et al. (2020) , are computationally expensive, creating a bottleneck for large-scale or real-time SA applications Gómez-Rodríguez and Vilares (2018) ; Strzyz et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh: 然而,基于词汇的方法的准确性取决于对语言现象的处理,如否定(“不好”)和强化(“非常好”),这些现象倾向于转变或改变情绪极性。 这些语言现象的范围相当复杂. 为了妥善处理,研究人员在基于规则的SA系统内综合了综合分析 Vilares等人(2017年); Imran等人(2026年b). 通过分析常通过Universal Defenities(UD)Zeman等人(2023年)代表的句子的合成结构,基于规则的系统可以应用递归性,组成性的规则来准确确定极性-转移元素的范围. 尽管在准确性和可解释性方面有这些优势,但常规的合成解析器,如Stanza Qi等人(2020年),计算成本昂贵,为大型或实时的SA应用Gómez-Rodríguez和Vilares(2018年);Strzyz等人(2019年)创造了瓶颈.

blocks.en:
A promising solution to this computational bottleneck is the reformulation of dependency parsing as a Sequence Labeling (SEL) task Gómez-Rodríguez and Vilares (2018) ; Strzyz et al. (2019) . SEL parsers rely on
lightweight scripts Roca et al. (2022) to linearize the tree structure into a sequence of labels, enabling the use of fast, off-the-shelf sequence taggers for syntactic analysis. Recent work by Imran et al. (2026b) successfully applied a Sequence Labeling Syntactic Parser (SELSP) within a rule-based sentiment analysis pipeline, demonstrating significant improvements in processing speed over traditional parsers while maintaining competitive accuracy for polarity classification.
blocks.zh:
解决这一计算瓶颈的一个有希望的办法是将依赖性重新划分为序列标签(SEL)任务Gómez-Rodríguez和Vilares(2018年);Strzyz等人(2019年)。 SEL 解析器依赖
轻量级脚本Roca等人(2022年)将树状结构线性化成一系列标签,从而能够使用快速的,现成的序列标记器进行合成分析. Imran等人(2026年b)最近的工作成功地在基于规则的情绪分析管道中应用了一种序列标签Syntactic Parser(SELSP),显示出处理速度比传统的剖析器有显著的改进,同时保持了极性分类的竞争精度.

blocks.en: While effective, the pipeline approach in Imran et al. (2026b) treats parsing and sentiment analysis as two discrete stages: first, a full parse tree is generated via sequence labeling, and then a separate rule-based engine computes sentiment from that structure. In this article, we propose two alternative strategies for integrating syntactic knowledge under a unified Multi - Task Learning (MTL) framework . Unlike prior work that uses a pipeline architecture—where a sequence labeling parser first generates a full parse tree, followed by a separate rule-based engine that computes sentiment from that structure—our proposed MTL models leverage syntactic annotations (generated by an accurate off-the-shelf parser) during training to provide an auxiliary learning signal, thereby eliminating the need for hand - crafted compositional rules or external parsing at inference time. Our first variant, Standard-MTL , employs explicit multi - task supervision by jointly training a shared encoder to predict sentiment polarity and dependency relation labels simultaneously. In contrast, our second variant, Contrastive-MTL , integrates syntax implicitly through a contrastive auxiliary objective and a syntax - biased attention pooling mechanism. Crucially, both models share an identical baseline sentiment architecture; the auxiliary syntactic signals are discarded at inference to ensure that any performance gains stem solely from the internalized linguistic structure learned during training.
blocks.zh: Imran等人(2026年b)的管道方法虽然有效,但将剖析和情绪分析作为两个离散阶段:首先,通过序列标签生成一个完整的剖析树,然后从该结构中计算出一个单独的基于规则的引擎。 在本篇文章中,我们提出了将综合知识纳入统一的多任务学习框架的两个备选战略。 与以前使用管道架构的工作不同——在管道架构中,一个序列标记解析器首先生成一个全解析树,然后是一个单独的基于规则的引擎,从该结构中计算情绪——我们提议的MTL模型在训练期间利用合成说明(由准确的现成解析器生成),以提供辅助学习信号,从而消除了对人工编译的构成规则或推断时间的外部解析的需要. 我们的第一个变体是标准-MTL,它采用明确的多任务监督,联合培训一个共享编码器,同时预测情绪极性和依赖关系标签。 对比之下,我们的第二个变体Contrastive-MTL通过一个对比性的辅助目标和一个语法——偏颇的注意力集中机制,将语法含蓄地融合起来. 关键的是,两个模型都有一个相同的基线情绪结构;辅助综合信号在推论中被丢弃,以确保任何性能的提高完全来自在培训过程中学到的内化语言结构.

blocks.en: Recent advances in contrastive learning have demonstrated the value of both sentence-level and token-level objectives. Sentence-level methods such as SimCSE Gao et al. (2021) , DeCLUTR Giorgi et al. (2021) , and supervised contrastive learning Khosla et al. (2020) learn robust representations by pulling together semantically similar sentences and pushing apart dissimilar ones. More recently, token-level objectives have proven effective in different settings: MEXMA Janeiro et al. (2025) combines sentence-level and token-level objectives for cross-lingual sentence encoders by predicting masked tokens across languages, while Critical Tokens Matter Lin et al. (2024) uses token-level contrastive estimation to identify and penalize critical tokens in LLM reasoning trajectories. These works establish that token-level signals can shape representations more effectively than sentence-level objectives alone. However, these methods either operate at the sentence/instance level or target cross-lingual encoding and LLM reasoning; none uses dependency relations as token-level contrastive signals for sentiment analysis. Our Contrastive-MTL fills this gap by combining token-level syntax and sentiment contrastive losses with syntax-biased attention pooling, injecting syntactic knowledge without requiring parsing at the inference stage.
blocks.zh: 最近对比性学习的进展表明了句子一级和象征一级目标的价值。 SimCSE Gao等人(2021年),DeCLUTR Giorgi等人(2021年),以及监督的对比性学习Khosla等人(2020年)等句级方法,通过拉拢相似的句子,推开不同句子来学习强势的表达. 最近,象征级目标在不同场合证明是有效的:MEXMA Janeiro等人(2025年)通过预测跨语言的蒙面符号将跨语言句子编码器的句子级和象征级目标结合起来,而Critical Tokens Matter Lin等人(2024年)则使用象征级对比性估计来识别和惩罚LLM推理轨迹中的关键符号. 这些作品确立了象征级信号可以比单句级目标更有效地塑造表示. 然而,这些方法要么在句子/内置层面运行,要么瞄准跨语言编码和LLM推理;没有一种依赖关系作为符号级对比信号用于情绪分析. 我们的对比-MTL通过将符号级语法和情绪对比损失与语法偏颇的注意力集中,注入综合知识,而不需要在推论阶段解析来填补这一空白.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold: (1) We present two complementary multi - task learning strategies for integrating syntactic information into sentiment analysis: Standard-MTL, which jointly learns dependency parsing as sequence labeling and sentiment classification, and MTL - Contrastive, which injects syntactic guidance implicitly through a contrastive auxiliary objective and syntax - biased attention pooling. (2) We evaluate both MTL variants on eleven datasets: MARC product reviews (spanning four language subsets) and seven SemEval-2022 Task 10 corpora covering hotel, news, and multi-domain reviews—across seven languages in total and using four sequence-labeling encodings. We then compare their performance against a single-task baseline (sentiment-only, without syntactic supervision), an external rule-based pipeline that parses at inference
(SELSP), and two ablations that isolate the contributions of the
contrastive losses and the attention bias.
(3) Through a mechanism analysis on a SemEval-2022 English dataset combining linear probing, inference-time attention analysis, and learned-bias inspection, we show that the contrastive objective produces encoder representations that are linearly separable by dependency relation, and
that the attention bias alone — without the contrastive anchor — degrades encoder-side syntactic encoding.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献有三个方面: (1) 我们提出两个互补的多任务学习战略,将综合信息纳入情绪分析:标准-MTL,它共同学习依赖性解析为序列标签和情绪分类;MTL-Contrastic,它通过对比性辅助目标和语法 -- -- 偏颇的注意力集中,间接地注入了综合指导。 (2) 我们在11个数据集上评价MTL两个变体:MARC产品审查(扩展4个语言子集)和7个SemEval-2022任务10公司审查(涵盖酒店、新闻和多领域审查)——总共跨越7种语言,并使用4个序列标签编码。 然后我们把它们的性能与单一任务基线(只同意,不进行综合监督)进行比较,这是一条基于规则的外部管道,可以推断

(3) 通过对SemEval-2022英文数据集的机制分析,结合线性测试、推断-时间关注分析以及学习-偏差检查,我们表明,对比性目标产生编码符表示,通过依赖关系可线性分离,
视线偏差 —— 没有对比锚 —— 降解编码器-侧合成编码。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Methods for SA are broadly categorized into Machine Learning/Deep Learning (ML/DL) approaches, lexicon-based methods, and hybrid techniques.
blocks.zh: SA的方法大致分为机器学习/深层学习(ML/DL)方法,基于词典的方法和混合技术.

blocks.en: 2.1 Supervised ML/DL methods
blocks.zh: 2.1 监督的ML/DL方法

blocks.en: Supervised ML/DL methods, including models based on LSTMs, CNNs, and pre-trained Transformers like BERT and RoBERTa, represent the current state of the art in academic benchmarks Cui et al. (2023) . These models excel when training and test data share similar characteristics but often require large, domain-specific annotated corpora and lack interpretability. Lexicon-based methods, conversely, utilize sentiment dictionaries and are prized for their simplicity, cross-domain robustness, and explainability, making them prevalent in industrial applications Taboada et al. (2011) ; Hutto and Gilbert (2014) ; Denecke and Reichenpfader (2023) . Hybrid approaches seek to combine the strengths of both, for example, by using lexicon-derived features to augment the input to a neural classifier Fu et al. (2018) .
blocks.zh: 监督的ML/DL方法,包括基于LSTMs,CNNs的模型,以及BERT和RoBERTA等经过预先训练的变形器,代表了学术基准Cui等人(2023年)的目前艺术状态. 这些模型在培训和测试数据具有类似特征但往往需要大型的、针对具体域的附加说明的公司和缺乏可解释性时非常出色。 反之,基于Lexicon的方法使用情绪词典,并因其简单、跨领域稳健和可解释性而受到奖励,使其在工业应用Taboada等人(2011年);Hutto和Gilbert(2014);Denecke和Reichenpfader(2023年)。 混合方法力求将两者的长处结合起来,例如,利用词汇衍生的特征增加对神经分类器Fu等人(2018年)的投入。

blocks.en: 2.2 Syntactic Parsing for Sentiment Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.2 感官分析系统分析

blocks.en: To address the challenge of determining the scope of polarity-shifting elements like negation, a well-established line of research employs syntactic rules that operate on parse trees. Universal Dependencies (UD) Zeman et al. (2023) has emerged as the dominant framework for this purpose due to its cross-lingual consistency and extensive treebank resources. Systems like those described by Vilares et al. (2017) and Imran et al. (2026b) ; Kellert et al. (2025a) use UD parse trees to apply bottom-up, compositional rules that modify and aggregate sentiment scores based on syntactic relations (e.g., adverbial modifiers for intensification, negation cues). This approach provides a linguistically motivated, transparent alternative to heuristic window-based scope detection Thelwall et al. (2010) or opaque ML classifiers for scope resolution Singh and Paul (2021) .
blocks.zh: 为了应对确定诸如否定等极性变化因素的范围的挑战,既定的一行研究采用在剖面树上运作的协同规则。 通用属地(UD)Zeman等人(2023年)由于具有多种语言的一致性和广泛的树库资源,因此已成为这方面的主导框架。 诸如Vilares等人(2017年)和Imran等人(2026年b)所描述的系统;Kellert等人(2025年a)利用UD剖析树应用自下而上、组成规则,这些规则根据综合关系(如强化的旁观修正剂、否定提示)来修改和汇总情绪分数。 这种方法在语言上具有动力,透明地替代了基于Heuristic windows的瞄准镜检测Thelwall等人(2010年),或者用于瞄准镜Singh和Paul(2021年)的不透明ML分类器.

blocks.en: 2.3 Dependency Parsing as Sequence Labeling
blocks.zh: 2.3 作为序列标签的依赖性分析

blocks.en:
The computational overhead of traditional transition-based or graph-based dependency parsers has motivated the development of faster alternatives. By encoding a dependency tree into a sequence of labels that can be predicted by a simple tagger, parsing is reduced to a sequence labeling task Gómez-Rodríguez and Vilares (2018) . The CoDeLin framework Strzyz et al. (2019) ; Roca et al. (2022) supports various encoding schemes, including absolute, relative and POS-based offsets and a range of bracketing-based encodings, which
can be used to represent a dependency tree as a sequence of one label per word. Imran et al. (2026b) demonstrated that a SEL parser (SELSP) trained with these encodings could be integrated into a rule-based SA pipeline, substantially improving parsing speed with minimal loss in downstream sentiment accuracy compared to Stanza.
blocks.zh:
传统的基于过渡或基于图表的依赖分析器的计算间接费用促使开发更快的替代品。 通过将依赖树编码成可以由简单的标记者预测的标签序列,解析被简化为标记任务Gómez-Rodríguez和Vilares(2018)的序列. CoDeLin框架 Strzyz等人(2019年);Roca等人。 (2022)支持各种编码方案,包括基于绝对值、相对值和基于POS的抵销以及一系列基于括号的编码,这些编码
可以用来代表一个依赖树作为每个词一个标签的序列. Imran等人(2026年b)表明,经过这些编码培训的SEL parser(SELSP)可并入基于规则的SA管道,与Stanza相比,大幅提高剖析速度,在下游情绪准确度方面损失最小。

blocks.en: 2.4 Multi-Task Learning in NLP
blocks.zh: 2.4 NLP中的多任务学习

blocks.en: Multi-Task Learning (MTL) is a paradigm in which a single model is trained to perform multiple related tasks simultaneously, leveraging shared representations to improve generalization and efficiency for all tasks van der Goot et al. (2021) . In NLP, MTL has been successfully applied to learn joint representations for a variety of tasks. Collobert and Weston (2008) pioneered a unified architecture for tasks like part-of-speech tagging, chunking, and named entity recognition. More recently, MTL has been used to infuse syntactic knowledge into semantic tasks. For instance, Swayamdipta et al. (2018) proposed a model that jointly learns syntactic chunking and semantic composition for sentence representations. Similarly, Zhang and Weiss (2016) showed that training a parser jointly with a sentence-level classification task (like sentiment) can lead to improved parsing accuracy. In the domain of syntactic parsing itself, MTL has been employed to jointly predict part-of-speech tags, morphological features, and dependency trees Kondratyuk and Straka (2019) .
blocks.zh: 多任务学习(MTL)是一种范式,在一个范德古特等人(2021年)中,对单一模式进行培训,以同时执行多个相关任务,利用共享的表示来提高所有任务的概括性和效率. 在NLP中,MTL被成功应用来学习各种任务的联合表述. Collobert和Weston(2008年)开创了一个统一的架构,用于部分语音标记、块和命名实体识别等任务。 最近,MTL被用于将综合知识注入语义任务. 例如,Swayamdipta等人(2018年)提出了一种模式,为句子表述共同学习合成块和语义组成。 同样,张和魏斯(2016年)也表明,与句子级分类任务(类似情绪)一起培训解析器可以提高解析精度. 在综合剖析自身领域,MTL被用于共同预测部分语义标记,形态特征,以及依附树Kondratyuk和Straka(2019年).

blocks.en: The incorporation of syntactic knowledge, ranging from dependency relations to constituent structures, has proven beneficial for handling complex linguistic phenomena in sentiment analysis, such as negation and intensification Poria et al. (2014) ; Gómez-Rodríguez et al. (2024) . Moreover, the effectiveness of parsing as sequence labeling has been further demonstrated in challenging multilingual settings, including code-switched and low-resource languages Kellert et al. (2025b) . In structured sentiment analysis, Imran et al. (2026a) linearize sentiment dependency graphs over holders, targets, and expressions and decode them through sequence labeling. However, that work targets fine-grained structured sentiment analysis: the sequence labeler predicts the graph structure itself, and the output at inference is a sentiment graph. In contrast, this study focuses on sentence/document-level sentiment polarity classification. Here, we use dependency parsing, formulated as sequence labeling, as an auxiliary training signal; the parser is discarded at inference, and the final output is a single polarity label for the input text. Thus, while both works exploit sequence labeling for dependency structures, they differ in task formulation, output space, and inference-time objective.
blocks.zh: 将从依赖关系到组成结构等各种综合知识纳入情感分析,已证明有助于处理复杂的语言现象,如否定和强化波里亚等人(2014年);戈麦斯-罗德里格斯等人(2024年)。 此外,在具有挑战性的多语种环境中,包括密码切换语言和低资源语言Kellert et al.(2025b),进一步证明了解析作为序列标签的有效性。 在结构化情绪分析中,Imran等人(2026a)将情绪依赖图线性化,凌驾于持有者,目标,表达方式之上,并通过序列标签解码. 然而,该工作的目标是精细的有条理的情绪分析:序列标签者预测图表结构本身,推论输出是一个情绪图. 相比之下,本研究侧重于句子/文件级情绪极性分类. 在这里,我们使用依赖解析,它被制定为序列标签,作为辅助训练信号;解析器在推断时被丢弃,最后输出是输入文本的单一极性标签. 因此,虽然这两种工作都为依赖性结构利用了序列标签,但在任务制定、产出空间和推断时间目标方面却各不相同。

blocks.en: Beyond sentiment analysis, syntactic supervision via MTL has also proven beneficial for other sequence labeling tasks, such as biomedical named entity recognition Imran et al. (2026c) . Our work builds upon these principles by applying MTL specifically to the combination of dependency parsing (as sequence labeling) and sentiment polarity classification, offering a unified alternative to the two-stage rule-based pipelines such as Imran et al. (2026b) ; Kellert et al. (2025a) which require parsing at inference time.
blocks.zh: 除了情绪分析外,通过MTL进行合成监督也已证明有利于其他序列标签工作,如生物医学命名实体识别Imran等人(2026年c). 我们的工作以这些原则为基础,具体将MTL应用于依赖性解析(作为序列标签)和情感极性分类的组合,为两阶段基于规则的管道提供了统一的替代方案,如Imran等人(2026年b);Kellert等人(2025年a),这需要推论时间解析。

blocks.en: 2.5 Token-Level Contrastive Learning
blocks.zh: 2.5 数据对比学习

blocks.en: Contrastive learning in NLP has largely focused on sentence-level objectives. SimCSE Gao et al. (2021) uses dropout as noise to create positive pairs, DeCLUTR Giorgi et al. (2021) constructs positive pairs from different spans of the same document, and supervised contrastive learning Khosla et al. (2020) uses class labels to define positive pairs. Although, these methods learn powerful sentence representations but do not explicitly model token-level syntactic structures.
blocks.zh: NLP中的矛盾学习主要侧重于句子层面的目标. SimCSE 数据 Gao等人(2021年)将辍学作为噪声生成正对,DeCLUTR Giorgi等人(2021年)从同一文档的不同跨度构造正对,监督对比学习Khosla等人(2020年)使用类标签定义正对. 虽然,这些方法学习了强大的句子表示法,但没有明确的模型符号层次的合成结构.

blocks.en: Token-level objectives have recently shown promise: MEXMA Janeiro et al. (2025) combined sentence-level and token-level objectives for cross-lingual sentence encoders by using the sentence representation in one language to predict masked tokens in another, improving bitext mining and downstream tasks. Critical Tokens Matter Lin et al. (2024) introduced token-level contrastive estimation to identify “critical tokens” in LLM reasoning trajectories and penalized them via contrastive direct preference optimization, improving reasoning accuracy. Neither uses dependency relation labels as a contrastive signal nor syntax-guided attention for sentiment analysis. Our work differs by defining token-level contrastive losses conditioned on dependency relations and sentiment labels, combined with syntax-biased attention pooling. To our knowledge, this is the first such formulation for sentiment analysis.
blocks.zh: Token一级的目标最近显示出了希望:MEXMA Janeiro等人(2025年)通过使用一种语言的句子表示来预测另一种语言的遮盖符号,改进比特ext挖掘和下游任务,将跨语言句子编码器的句子级别和符号级别的目标结合在一起. Critical Tokens Matter Lin等人(2024年)引入了符号级对比性估计,以识别LLM推理轨迹中的"关键符号",并通过对比性直接偏好优化对其进行惩罚,提高了推理精度. 既不使用依赖关系标签作为对比信号,也不使用语法引导的注意力进行情绪分析. 我们的工作不同,以依赖关系和情绪标签为条件,加上有语法偏见的注意力集中,来界定象征性的对比性损失。 据我们所知,这是第一次进行情绪分析。

blocks.en:
We performed experiments on the Multilingual Amazon Reviews Corpus (MARC) 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/mteb/amazon_reviews_multi/tree/main Keung et al. (2020) a large collection of Amazon reviews for multilingual text in four languages (English, Spanish, French and German). Each review in this dataset provides a 5-star rating (1–5, mapped to labels 0–4 corresponding to very negative, negative, neutral, positive, and very positive, respectively) at the review level, making it well-suited for multilingual text classification. Furthermore, we performed experiments on the five datasets released in the SemEval-2022 Task 10:
the OpeNER dataset ( Agerri et al., 2013 , OpN;) with English and Spanish annotations,
the English Multi-Perspective Question Answer corpus ( Wiebe et al., 2005 , MPQA;) and the Darmstadt Universities corpus ( Toprak et al., 2010 , DS;) , the Norwegian NoReC dataset Velldal et al. (2018) and the Basque and Catalan MultiBooked dataset ( Barnes et al., 2018 , MB;) .

我们进行了多语种亚马逊评论公司(MARC)的实验 11 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/mteb/amazon_reviews_multi/tree/main 强等. (2020年) 大量亚马逊评论集,用于四种语言(英语,西班牙语,法语和德语)的多语种文本. 本数据集中的每一份评论都提供5星级(1–5)的评分,标注在0–4的标签上,分别对应非常消极,消极,中立,正面和非常正面的评分,使其非常适合多语种文本分类. 此外,我们还对SemEval-2022任务10中发布的五个数据集进行了实验:

blocks.en: In SemEval-2022 Task 10 datasets, every review is annotated with the individual polarity expressions and their polarity (positive or negative) as demonstrated by few simple examples of reviews in Table 1 from Barnes et al. (2022) that only contain one polarity expression. Since our problem of interest is polarity classification, we extract review-level sentiment labels from the structured opinion annotations as described in Algorithm 1 . Each review in the dataset contains an opinions field consisting of tuples ( P , I , E ) (P,I,E) , where P ∈ { Positive , Negative , Neutral } P\in\{\text{Positive},\text{Negative},\text{Neutral}\} is the polarity, I ∈ { Strong , Standard or Average , Weak } I\in\{\text{Strong},\text{Standard or Average},\text{Weak}\} , is the intensity, and E E is the polar expression span. We discard reviews that contain no polarity expressions at all (i.e., the opinions field is empty), so our evaluation is comprised only on reviews that do contain subjectivity. For reviews with multiple polarity expressions, we compute an aggregate review-level polarity label by scoring each opinion based on both its polarity and intensity: Positive opinions contribute + 2 +2 if Strong and + 1 +1 otherwise, Negative opinions contribute − 2 -2 if Strong and − 1 -1 otherwise, and Neutral opinions are tracked but do not affect the score. The final gold polarity label is determined by comparing the aggregated positive and negative scores: the label is Positive if the positive score exceeds the negative score, Negative if the negative score exceeds the positive score, and Neutral if the scores are tied and at least one non-neutral or neutral opinion exists. We thus have a task of predicting three polarity labels ( Positive , Negative , and Neutral ) on these datasets. The statistics of these datasets, including the number of discarded and remaining reviews per split, are presented in Table 2 .

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
We propose two multi-task learning (MTL) strategies that integrate syntactic knowledge into a sentiment analysis model without requiring hand-crafted rules or external parsing at inference time. Both approaches share a common transformer encoder and a sentiment classification head, but differ in how they leverage automatically obtained dependency annotations during training as shown in Figure 1 . The first, Standard-MTL, casts dependency parsing (sequence labeling) as an explicit auxiliary task, jointly trained with sentiment prediction. The second, Contrastive-MTL, integrates syntax implicitly through a contrastive auxiliary objective and a syntax-biased attention pooling mechanism.
The auxiliary syntactic components—including the dependency parsing head in Standard-MTL, and the syntax-guided attention pooling together with the contrastive projection head in Contrastive-MTL—are discarded after training. At inference, both models use a standard sentiment head over a plain pooling mechanism; in particular, Contrastive-MTL replaces the syntax-guided attention with a learned attention pooling that has no access to dependency relation labels.

我们提出两个多任务学习战略,将综合知识纳入情绪分析模型,而不需要手工规则或推断时间的外部解析. 如图1所示,两种方法都有一个通用的变压器编码器和一个情绪分类头,但在培训期间如何利用自动获得的依赖说明方面有所不同。 第一种是标准-MTL,将依赖性解析(序列标签)作为一种明确的辅助任务,通过情绪预测共同培训。 第二部"Contrastive-MTL"通过对比性辅助目标和语法偏差的注意力集中机制,将语法含蓄地融合起来.
辅助合成组件——包括标准-MTL中的依赖解析头和语法引导的注意力集中与Contrastive-MTL中的对比预测头——在培训后被放弃。 推论,两种模型都使用标准情绪头顶着一个简单的集合机制;特别是Contrastive-MTL用一个没有依赖关系标签的学习到的注意力集合来取代语法引导的注意力.

blocks.en: The Standard-MTL model jointly learns to predict sentiment and dependency parses through explicit multi-task supervision. The architecture consists of a shared transformer encoder (XLM-RoBERTa-large, Conneau et al. (2020) ) and two separate task heads. The transformer-based XLM-RoBERTa-large was selected as the backbone encoder due to its proven effectiveness in cross-lingual settings and its ability to produce rich contextualized token representations essential for both dependency parsing (sequence labeling) and sentiment classification.

blocks.en: By jointly optimizing sentiment classification and dependency parsing, the shared encoder learns to capture syntactic regularities—such as negation scope and modifier attachments—that are crucial to determine the sentiment polarity. The auxiliary parsing task prevents the encoder from overfitting to superficial lexical cues, encouraging it to build representations that are more robust to word order and syntactic variation. Consequently, the sentiment head benefits from a syntax-enriched feature space, leading to improved performance without requiring any additional computation at inference time.
blocks.zh: 通过共同优化情绪分类和依赖分析,共享编码器学会捕捉对确定情绪极性至关重要的协同规律——如否定范围和修饰附件。 辅助解析任务可以防止编码器过度适应肤浅的词汇提示,鼓励它构建更加坚固的表达方式来表达文字顺序和合成变化. 因此,情绪头部得益于语法丰富的特征空间,导致性能改善,无需在推论时进行额外计算。

blocks.en: 4.2 Multi-Task Contrastive Learning with Syntax-Guided Attention
blocks.zh: 4.2 有语法指导的多任务矛盾学习

blocks.en: The Contrastive-MTL variant integrates syntactic information implicitly through two mechanisms: a syntax-guided attention pooling module and a pair of contrastive auxiliary objectives operating on token-level representations. The sentiment classification backbone is identical to that of Standard-MTL, except for the pooling step.

blocks.en: The contrastive auxiliary objectives and syntax-guided attention pooling implicitly distill syntactic knowledge into token representations. By pulling together tokens that share the same dependency relation or belong to sentences with the same sentiment, the model learns to associate specific syntactic roles (e.g., nsubj, amod) with sentiment expression, while the learnable attention bias further emphasizes relationally important tokens. This implicit syntactic shaping yields a more discriminative sentence representation, enabling the sentiment classifier to generalize better across syntactically diverse inputs—all without explicit parsing at the inference time.
blocks.zh: 对比性的辅助目标和语法引导的注意力汇集了含蓄地将合成知识蒸馏成符号表示. 通过拉拢具有相同依赖关系或属于具有相同情感的句子的符号,模型学习将特定的合成角色(如nsubj,amod)与情绪表达联系起来,而可学习的注意力偏差则进一步强调关系上重要的符号. 这种隐含的合成方式产生了一种更具有歧视性的句子表述,使情绪分类器能够更好地概括各种不同的综合投入,而无需在推断时作出明确解释。

blocks.en: Table 4 presents a comparison of Standard Multi-Task Learning (Standard-MTL) and Contrastive Multi-Task Learning (Contrastive-MTL), both incorporating syntactic knowledge, against a baseline model without syntactic information and an external rule-based pipeline (SELSP) that requires parsing at inference time. While we report results for all encoding schemes, our primary analysis focuses on the relative encoding, which achieves the best overall performance and provides the most consistent improvements over both the baseline and SELSP. Note that SELSP only supports English and Spanish; consequently, it could not be applied to the remaining five datasets, which are in Catalan, Basque, Norwegian, French, and German.
blocks.zh: 表4比较了标准多任务学习(Standard-MTL)和矛盾多任务学习(Contrastive-MTL),两者都包含综合知识,与一个没有综合信息的基线模型和一个需要推论时间解析的基于规则的外部管道(SELSP). 在我们报告所有编码计划的结果的同时,我们的主要分析重点是相对编码,这种编码取得了最佳的总体业绩,比基线和SELSP提供了最一致的改进。 请注意,SELSP只支持英语和西班牙语;因此,它不能应用于其余五个数据集,即加泰罗尼亚语、巴斯克语、挪威语、法语和德语。

blocks.en: With the relative encoding, Contrastive-MTL outperforms the baseline on 10 out of 11 datasets. The only exception is MPQA, where the baseline remains ahead (0.723 vs. 0.684). This consistency contrasts with Standard-MTL, which beats the baseline on only 6 out of 11 datasets with the same encoding. The gap between the two MTL variants is most pronounced on datasets with rich syntactic structure: on MultiBooked ca , Contrastive-MTL improves over the baseline by +0.084 F1 versus +0.065 for Standard-MTL; on OpeNER es , the improvement is +0.120 versus +0.083. On the MARC datasets, differences are narrower but consistent, with Contrastive-MTL achieving the best F1-scores across all four language subsets. Figure 2 visualises these Δ \Delta F1 values as a heatmap for all four encodings. Contrastive-MTL is positive on at least 9 of 11 datasets under every encoding (10 of 11 under BrkBased and Relative), while Standard-MTL is positive on at most 6 of 11 under every encoding and shows clearly negative regions on MPQA and MultiBooked eu .
blocks.zh: 相对编码后,Contrastive-MTL在11个数据集中,有10个数据集的运行情况超过了基线. 唯一的例外是MPQA,其基线仍然在前面(0.723对0.684)。 这种一致性与标准-MTL形成对比,标准-MTL在11个数据集中,只有6个编码相同,从而击败了基线. 两个MTL变体之间的差距在具有丰富合成结构的数据集上最为明显:在MultiBooked ca 上,Contrastive-MTL比基准值提高+0.084 F1,标准-MTL则提高+0.065;在OpeNER es 上,改进为+0.120,相对于+0.083. 在MARC数据集上,差异较小但一致,Contrastive-MTL在所有四个语言子集中都实现了最好的F1分数. 图2可视化这些\\Delta F1值,作为所有四个编码的热映射. 每个编码下至少11个数据集中有9个对比-MTL是正数(Brk Based and Release下11个数据集中有10个),而标准-MTL在每个编码下至少11个数据集中有6个对比-MTL是正数,并在MPQA和MultiBooked eu上显示明显的负数区域.

blocks.en: Turning to SELSP, which is available for the six English and Spanish datasets, Contrastive-MTL with the relative encoding outperforms it on all six, whereas Standard-MTL beats SELSP on five out of six, falling short only on OpeNER es (0.770 vs. 0.788) as visualized in Figure 3 . This is particularly notable given that SELSP explicitly parses the input at inference time, while our MTL models discard the parser after training. On the two datasets where SELSP is most competitive—OpeNER es (SELSP F1 = 0.788) and OpeNER en (SELSP F1 = 0.682)—Contrastive-MTL with the relative encoding achieves F1-scores of 0.807 and 0.804, respectively, demonstrating that implicit syntactic supervision during training can match or exceed the performance of explicit parsing at inference.
blocks.zh: 转到SELSP,6个英语和西班牙语数据集都可以使用,Contrastive-MTL与相对编码的性能在所有6个数据上都超过了它,而标准-MTL则在SELSP的六分之五上击败了它,在OpeNER es(0.770 vs. 0.788)上只有不足,如图3所示。 这一点特别值得注意,因为SELSP在推断时明确解析输入,而我们的MTL模型在训练后放弃了解析器. 在SELSP最具有竞争力的两个数据集上——OpeNER es(SELSP F1 = 0.788)和OpeNER en(SELSP F1 = 0.682)——与相对编码的Contrastive-MTL分别达到F1-分数0.807和0.804,表明培训期间的隐含合成监督可以匹配或超过在推论中明确解析的表现.

blocks.en: Although the relative encoding yields the strongest overall results, the pattern is consistent across the four tested encodings. Contrastive-MTL beats the baseline on 9–10 out of 11 datasets depending on the encoding, while Standard-MTL beats it on only 5–6. Figure 4 shows this encoding-by-encoding robustness directly: Contrastive-MTL is at or above baseline on 39 of the 44 dataset–encoding combinations (with a single exact tie at MARC en under the Absolute encoding), and the only regressions are small ( | Δ | ≤ 0.04 |\Delta|\leq 0.04 , all on MPQA, OpeNER en and MARC es ). In contrast, Standard-MTL drops below baseline in 21 of the 44 combinations, most severely on MPQA (down to − 0.133 -0.133 ). This indicates that the advantage of Contrastive-MTL is not an artifact of a particular encoding scheme but reflects a more effective integration of syntactic information.
blocks.zh: 尽管相对编码产生最强的整体结果,但四个测试编码的图案是一致的. Contrastive-MTL根据编码在11个数据集中9–10击败基线,而标准-MTL则仅以5–6击败基线. 图4直接显示了这种编码的强性: Contrastive-MTL在44个数据集-编码组合中的39个处于或高于基线(在绝对编码下MARC en有一个单一的精确的平局),唯一的回归是小的(QQ | 0.04 |\ Delta|\leq 0.04,全部在MPQA,OpeNER en和MARC es上). 相比之下,标准-MTL在44种组合中的21种低于基线,最严重的是在MPQA(降至−0.133-0.133). 这表明,Contrastive-MTL的优势不是特定编码方案的一件艺术品,而是反映了对综合信息的更有效的整合。

blocks.en: 5.2 Computational Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.2 计算效率

blocks.en: Table 6 reports training and evaluation times. SELSP is an external rule-based pipeline and is therefore not trained; its evaluation time is only reported for the English and Spanish datasets it supports. MTL variants require longer training times on some datasets relative to baseline, as seen on MultiBooked eu (652–664 vs. 263 s) or OpeNER es (653–851 vs. 459 s). However, the pattern reverses on other datasets: on NoReC, Standard-MTL trains faster than baseline (3026 vs. 4700 s), and on OpeNER en , Contrastive-MTL is also faster (693 vs. 817 s). Between MTL variants, Contrastive-MTL is often more expensive to train than Standard-MTL (e.g., MPQA and MARC fr ), though not always (e.g., OpeNER en and Darmstadt_unis). Inference times, by contrast, remain nearly identical across baseline, Standard-MTL, and Contrastive-MTL, since the parser is discarded after training.

blocks.en: The Contrastive-only MTL variant exhibits the most consistent pattern: across most datasets and encodings, it matches or exceeds the shared baseline, and it frequently attains the best or tied-best F1. This trend is especially clear on Darmstadt_unis, MultiBooked_ca, NoReC, OpeNER es , and MARC de , where the contrastive-only model broadly improves over the baseline. On MPQA, by contrast, it underperforms the baseline on three of the four encodings (Brk7Bits, BrkBased, and Relative), recovering above it only with the Absolute encoding. On MultiBooked eu and MARC es , it still reaches best or tied-best scores in some settings, although these gains are less uniform. These results indicate that contrastive learning alone provides a robust and transferable benefit on many, though not all, datasets.
blocks.zh: Contrestive-唯一 MTL 变体表现出最一致的模式:在大多数数据集和编码中,它匹配或超过共享基线,并经常达到最佳或捆绑最好的F1. 这一趋势在达姆施塔特_unis,MultiBooked_ca,NoReC,OpeNER es,以及MARC de 中尤其明显,这里的对比性唯一模型比基线大有改善. 相比之下,在MPQA上,它在四个编码(Brk7Bits,BrkBased,和Present)中的三个编码上的基线表现不佳,只用绝对编码在它的上面恢复. 在MultiBooked eu 和 MARC es 上,虽然这些成绩不太一致,但在某些环境中,它仍然达到最佳或捆绑得分。 这些结果表明,单靠对比性学习就能为许多(尽管不是全部)数据集提供有力和可转移的好处。

blocks.en: The Syntax-only MTL variant shows a more mixed pattern. It yields notable improvements on OpeNER en and MARC en , and matches the best contrastive-only result on MultiBooked eu and MARC es in selected encodings. However, it often degrades performance relative to the baseline, particularly on MARC es , MPQA, and MARC fr , as well as the Absolute encoding on OpeNER es . Thus, syntax-guided attention alone does not reliably improve performance.
blocks.zh: 单语法的 MTL 变体显示了一种比较混合的模式. 它在 OpeNER en 和 MARC en 上取得了显著的改进,并匹配了选定编码中MultiBooked eu 和 MARC es 的最佳对比性唯一结果。 然而,它往往比基线,特别是MARC es、MPQA和MARC fr,以及OpeNER es上的绝对编码,降低性能。 因此,单靠语法指导的注意并不能可靠地改善性能.

blocks.en: A direct comparison between the two ablated modules shows that Contrastive-only MTL achieves the highest single-component scores in more settings than Syntax-only MTL (seven datasets versus two, with two tied), indicating that the contrastive objective is the more robust individual component. However, neither ablation reproduces the full model’s performance: taking the best encoding per dataset, the full Contrastive-MTL model outperforms both ablations on ten of the eleven datasets. This indicates that the syntax bias, while not reliably beneficial in isolation, provides complementary gains when combined with the contrastive objectives.
blocks.zh: 对两个被降级的模块进行直接比较后发现,Contrestive-Only MTL在比语法化的MTL(7个数据集对2个,绑定两个)的环境下实现最高的单元分数,表明对比性目标是更强的单个组件. 然而,两者都不复制整个模型的性能:每个数据集都采用最好的编码,完整的Contrastive-MTL模型在11个数据集的10个上都超越了两者。 这表明语法偏差虽然在孤立中并不可靠地有利,但在与对比目标相结合时提供互补收益.

blocks.en: 7 Mechanism Analysis
blocks.zh: 7 机制分析

blocks.en: The ablation in Table 5 establishes that the contrastive objective drives downstream performance, but it leaves open the mechanism by which it does so. We examine that mechanism on OpeNER en as a case study from three angles: (i) which syntactic roles the trained model attends to at inference time (§ 7.1 ); (ii) what syntactic signal the training-time attention bias learned and subsequently discarded (§ 7.2 ); and (iii) whether the encoder internalizes syntactic structure, as measured by a linear probe on frozen representations (§ 7.3 ).
blocks.zh: 表5中的删减确定了对比性目标驱动下游的性能,但留下了这样做的机制。 我们从三个角度审查关于OpeNER en的这一机制,作为案例研究:(一) 训练有素的模型在推断时间(第7.1节);(二) 何种综合表示所学到并随后放弃的训练时间注意力偏差(第7.2节);以及(三) 编码器是否通过对冷冻表达的线性探测器测量到的合成结构(第7.3节)。

blocks.en: 7.1 Attention Analysis
blocks.zh: 7.1 注意分析

blocks.en: Figure 6 plots the mean inference-time attention weight assigned to each dependency relation, aggregated over all annotated test tokens as reported in Table 7 . The highest attention is assigned to advmod ( a ¯ = 0.076 \bar{a}=0.076 ) and amod ( a ¯ = 0.066 \bar{a}=0.066 )—the two relations that carry intensifiers (“very good”) and sentiment-bearing adjectives (“clean rooms”). The neg ranks above the median ( a ¯ = 0.054 \bar{a}=0.054 ) despite comprising only 63 test tokens. At the bottom of the distribution, the model assigns minimal attention to det ( a ¯ = 0.024 \bar{a}=0.024 ) and poss ( a ¯ = 0.028 \bar{a}=0.028 )—the two function-word relations that carry no sentiment content. This is the pattern that rule-based sentiment systems predict: at inference time the model concentrates its pooling mass on the same syntactic roles that rule-based systems have hand-engineered for polarity composition. It is an emergent property of the encoder’s learned representation under the contrastive objective—not of the syntax-guided attention bias, which is discarded at inference.

blocks.en: To test whether the encoder itself internalizes syntax, we freeze the encoder and train a fresh linear probe on the frozen token representations to predict the gold UD relation of each annotated token. The probe is a single linear layer ( d = 1024 d{=}1024 input, one output per relation class) trained for 30 epochs with AdamW (lr 10 − 3 10^{-3} ), batch size 1024 1024 , and no regularization; it is trained on the training split and evaluated on the test split.

blocks.en: First, the baseline encoder is not learning syntax. It scores near or above 0.79 on det and punct —relations that are predictable from the token itself (“the”, “a”, “.”)—and near chance on context-dependent relations ( nsubj 0.69, cop 0.28, neg 0.08, advmod 0.37). The baseline’s overall accuracy of 0.462 is therefore a lexical prior, not a syntactic signal.
blocks.zh: 首先,基线编码器不是学习语法. 它的得分接近或超过0.79分的分数是:从象征本身(““a”、“.”)可以预测的关系,以及依赖背景的关系(nsubj 0.69、cop 0.28、neg 0.08、dvmod 0.37)几乎是偶然的。 因此,基线0.462的总体准确性是词汇上的先兆,而不是综合信号。

blocks.en: Second, the contrastive objective creates syntactic structure. Both models trained with the contrastive losses—Contrastive-MTL and Contrastive-only MTL—raise accuracy on every context-dependent relation to above 0.90 ( nsubj 0.92–0.94, advmod 0.91, cop 0.96, neg 0.98), a jump of between + 0.24 +0.24 and + 0.91 +0.91 absolute over the baseline. On relations that are trivially predictable from token identity ( det , punct ), the gain is small or zero, as expected. The contrastive objective specifically internalizes the syntactic distinctions that are not lexically derivable.
blocks.zh: 第二,对比性目标产生协同结构. 这两种模型都经过了对比性损失——Contrastive-MTL和Contrestive-Only MTL——对0.90以上(nsubj 0.92-0.94, advmod 0.91, cop 0.96, neg 0.98)的每个上下文依赖关系提高精确度,比基线的绝对值在0.24+0.24和+ 0.91+0.91之间。 对于从象征身份(det, punct)上微不足道的可预见关系,收益是小或零,如预期. 对比性目标具体地将无法从逻辑上推导的合成区分内在化。

blocks.en:
Third, the attention bias without the contrastive objective degrades the encoder’s syntactic encoding, even though the ablation in Table 5 shows that its downstream F1 remains competitive on OpeNER en . Syntax-only MTL achieves probe
accuracy of 0.298, well below the baseline’s 0.462. The mechanism is a shortcut: with relation labels available to the pooling layer at each training step, the sentiment head can access relation information directly, and the encoder has no incentive to encode relations itself; sentiment fine-tuning then partially erases the pretrained syntactic features. The result is a model whose pooling layer knows which relations matter for sentiment but whose encoder knows less syntax than a model that was never trained on syntax at all. This is the same shortcut-learning phenomenon documented in the NLP literature ( Gururangan et al., 2018 ; Niven and Kao, 2019 ) .

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we explored two multi-task learning strategies for integrating syntactic
information into neural polarity classification models without incurring the computational
overhead of external parsers at inference time. Our proposed approaches—Standard-MTL,
which jointly learns dependency parsing as sequence labeling alongside polarity
classification, and Contrastive-MTL, which injects syntactic guidance implicitly through
a contrastive auxiliary objective and syntax-biased attention pooling—were evaluated on
eleven multilingual benchmark datasets across four encoding schemes.

blocks.en: A mechanism analysis on OpeNER en clarifies the source of these gains. Linear probes on frozen encoder representations show that the contrastive objective raises probe accuracy on dependency relations from 0.46 (baseline) to 0.92, with the gain concentrated on context-dependent relations ( nsubj , advmod , cop , neg ) rather than on relations predictable from token identity alone ( det , punct ). Attention analysis shows that inference-time pooling mass on the Contrastive-MTL model concentrates on precisely these relations and minimizes function-word relations, while the learned training-time bias on advmod and neg is positive and on det is near zero. These complementary signals support the interpretation that the contrastive objective shapes the encoder to encode the syntactic distinctions that matter for sentiment, and the sentiment head at inference reweights tokens by those distinctions.

Finally, both MTL variants discard the auxiliary syntactic components after training, so
inference times remain nearly identical to the baseline, whereas SELSP is 1.6 1.6 – 9.2 × 9.2\times slower at evaluation due to parsing overhead. This design preserves the efficiency of single-task models while offering a principled alternative to pipeline architectures that rely on full parse tree generation and hand-crafted compositional rules.

blocks.en: 9 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 9 限制和未来方向

blocks.en:
Despite the promising results, we acknowledge the limitations of our study. First, the MTL models
rely on syntactic annotations produced by an off-the-shelf biaffine dependency parser Dozat and Manning (2017) during training, so any systematic errors or biases in
the parser’s output may propagate to the MTL framework; the contrastive objective could,
in principle, learn to cluster tokens around incorrect relation labels, potentially
harming generalization.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了有希望的成果,但我们承认我们研究的局限性。 首先,MTL模型
依靠现成的双叶林依赖者在培训期间制作的合成说明,解说Dozat和Manning(2017年),因此任何系统性错误或偏差
剖析器的产出可能传播到MTL框架;对比性目标可能,
原则上,学习围绕不正确的关系标签将符号分组,可能
伤害一般化。

blocks.en:
These limitations open several avenues for future research. Extending the framework to
fine-grained and aspect-based sentiment analysis is a natural next step, where token-level
contrastive objectives aligned with aspect terms and opinion targets could enable the
model to learn richer associations between UD relations (e.g., nsubj , obj , amod ) and specific sentiment expressions, thereby handling multi-aspect reviews
with contrasting polarities. A second direction is to explore alternative syntactic
representations—constituency parses, phrase-structure trees, or lightweight syntactic
features such as negation scope markers and intensifier chains—under the same
contrastive framework, in order to identify the optimal trade-off between linguistic
richness and learning efficiency.
